core_principle: The planner never emits a surface word. Every leaf of this structure is an identifier or an enumerated role.

fact_addressing.condition: <claim_id>#COND<index> into the claim's own frozen conditions
fact_addressing.numeric: <claim_id>#NUM<index> into the claim's own frozen numeric records
fact_addressing.qualifier: <claim_id>#QUAL<index>, or a registered qualifier-semantics constraint id whose declared claim matches
fact_addressing.rationale: an id that embeds its own claim cannot address another claim's fact, which is what closes cross-claim source laundering at parse time

mechanisms: closed schema — every object declares its permitted keys and an undeclared key is a rejection, so prose cannot enter under an innocent name
prose-name blocklist — a tripwire for the obvious case, listed as PROSE_FIELD_NAMES
typed leaves — every surviving leaf is an id matching ID_RE, which admits no whitespace and at most 64 characters, so a sentence cannot be spelled as one

purpose: the symbolic structure a planner emits. It carries which claims are stated, in what order and in what role, and no words.

realization_roles.CLAIM_STATEMENT: the claim's own proposition, from its approved canonical semantics
realization_roles.CONDITION: a condition the claim carries, in its approved realization
realization_roles.EXEMPLIFICATION: an exemplification the claim's own text carries
realization_roles.IDENTITY_SCOPE: what a referenced table or clause *is*, where a frozen field states it
realization_roles.NUMERIC_CRITERIA: the claim's registered numeric records with their source-stated units
realization_roles.REQUIREMENT: the claim's proposition where the claim itself carries binding modality

unknown_role_policy: reject; there is no default and no degradation
validation_proves_before_rendering: the claim is allowlisted and composition-safe
every cited source key is registered to the declaring claim
every requested numeric is registered to the claim and source-stated
every requested condition belongs to the claim
every requested qualifier constraint belongs to the claim
the relation is allowed by the claim and forbidden by none
only INDEPENDENT is renderable without a source that states the relation
the claim/role pair has a frozen realization and is not UNREALIZABLE
a paragraph-scoped required meaning has a slot in its own paragraph
a registered qualifier has a slot wherever its claim is stated
a supporting role never stands without the statement it supports
a claim holds at most one statement role per paragraph
a paragraph-scoped condition has a slot in its own paragraph
